description.narrative:
Overall project objective:
Contribute to the protection of the environment, the conservation of forests and adaptation and mitigation to climate change and a sustainable economic development of the Amazon region, through the strengthening of sustainable production models, public-private multi-stakeholder platforms and the empowerment of women and men leaders of productive family units.
The main lines of actions are as follows:
1) Conservation, Preservation and Restoration of Amazon Forests
- Contribute to the conservation and protection of 152,000 ha of Amazon forest, with the implementation of 400 ha of Successional Agroforestry Systems (SAS) with species of commercial and food value, in forest buffer areas in 5 municipalities in Pando.
- Intensified land use with 150 ha of sustainable managed regenerative grazing, including practices of plot rotation and rest periods, efficient use of pastures and increased animal load without the need to deforest new areas and avoiding the use of logging and burning.
- Conservation of native forests and the restoration of degraded areas.
-Research on carbon stock sequestration in SAS and regenerative grazing, as a contribution to climate change mitigation.
2) Sustainable production models with biodiversity and profitability
- Articulate the SAS and regenerative grazing strategies to 400 families for the overcoming of multidimensional poverty.
- Increase production opportunities and access to national and international markets.
- Facilitate the collection and transformation of products from agroforestry systems through the strengthening of current producer associations and their articulation with the different business and commercial arms.
- Contribute to the innovation and quality of products, to reach dynamic markets through the application of new processes and the introduction of new techniques and technologies for the establishment of successful initiatives.
3) Strengthening public-private multi-stakeholder platforms
- Establish a consensual mechanism in a public-private multi-stakeholder platform, to seek synergies, manage knowledge and exchange experiences, through close coordination between all the organizations present in the region.
- Capacity building to develop partnerships with the public or private sector as "assets" for environmental forest services.
- Support the development of relevant regulations for the comprehensive planning of the territory.
4) Women's empowerment with a multidimensional approach to poverty
- Comprehensive training of 400 families, 60% of whom are women leaders of Productive Family Units (with technical and technological capacities for production, entrepreneurial skills and personal skills and the exercise of rights).
- Contribute to reducing gender inequality, violence, adolescent pregnancy and increasing access to services and opportunities for the population.
- Technical training based on production protocols feeds the training programs considering the positive discrimination of women protectors who take care of the forest to ensure its sustainability.

Project: Environmental protection, climate change adaptation and mitigation and sustainable economic development in Bolivia: "NOT ONE TREE LESS". FAUTAPO is a well established Bolivian Foundation - non-profitorganisation- authorised by the Bolivian legislation to develop its activities according to its approved statutes and purposes. Sweden has already entered in several agreements with FAUTAPO in the last fifteen years with important and relevant results. The overall project objective is to contribute to the protection of the environment, the conservation of forests and adaptation and mitigation to climate change and a sustainable economic development of the Amazon region, through the strengthening of sustainable production models, public-private multi-stakeholder platforms and the empowerment of women and men leaders of productive family units. Lines of action: 1. Conservation, Preservation and Restoration of Amazon Forests 2. Sustainable production models with biodiversity and profitability 3. Strengthening public-private multi-stakeholder platform 4. Women's empowerment with a multidimensional approach to poverty

Projekt: Miljöskydd, anpassning till och begränsning av klimatförändringar och hållbar ekonomisk utveckling i Bolivia: "INTE ETT TRÄD MINDRE" FAUTAPO är en väletablerad boliviansk stiftelse - icke-vinstdrivande organisation - som enligt boliviansk lagstiftning har tillstånd att utveckla sin verksamhet i enlighet med sina godkända stadgar och syften. Sverige har redan ingått flera avtal med FAUTAPO under de senaste femton åren med viktiga och relevanta resultat. Det övergripande projektets mål är att bidra till miljöskydd, bevarande av skogar och anpassning till och begränsning av klimatförändringar och en hållbar ekonomisk utveckling i Amazonasregionen genom att stärka hållbara produktionsmodeller, offentlig-privata flerpartsplattformar och stärka kvinnors och mäns ställning som ledare för produktiva familjeenheter. Handlingslinjer: 1. Bevarande, bevarande och restaurering av Amazonas skogar 2. Hållbara produktionsmodeller med biologisk mångfald och lönsamhet 3. Förstärkning av den offentlig-privata flerpartsplattformen 4. Kvinnors egenmakt med en flerdimensionell syn på fattigdom

Municipal Authorities have signed agreements with FAUTAPO, to implement public policies in forest area management and biodiversity conservation and forest fire prevention: Provision of infrastructure for coffee plant, shared implementation of actions.
Community Conservation Agreements entered an implementation phase involving systematic monitoring and evaluation within buffer zones, aimed at enhancing forest conservation efforts.
Direct and indirect beneficiaries from selected associations are currently engaged in capacity-building processes aimed at the application of sustainable forest management practices through Successional Agroforestry Systems (SAS).
CO capture estimation research in agroforestry systems was carried out by implementing soil and root sampling protocols in permanent monitoring fields.
Improved model of coffee production in Successional Agroforestry Systems implemented (SAS).
Implementation of a regenerative grazing production model in several municipalities.
Access of Family Production Units to secure markets for the commercialization of agroforestry products and financial education for access to credit.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
